description_en: Create a skill group based on the skill group name and channel type
description_zh: 根据技能组名称和渠道类型创建技能组
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs create-skill-group --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --skill-group-name '在线自动化技能组' --description '在线自动化技能组' --display-name '在线自动化技能组' --channel-type 2 --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-0000-70b6a298d94d --department-id 123 --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSkillGroup

parameters.help_en:
Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh:
AICCS实例ID。
您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: External display name of the skill group
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en:
Channel type of the skill group. Valid values:

1: Hotline.
2: Online.
3: Ticket
parameters.help_zh:
技能组类型。取值：

1：热线。
2：在线。
3：工单
parameters.name: channel_type

parameters.help_en: Unique ID of the customer request. Used for idempotency validation. You can generate it using UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
